name: Backend Engineer
description: Build and maintain backend services and APIs. The role covers data storage, testing, security, and production reliability. Assess only professional evidence stated in the resume.

criteria.name: API development
criteria.description: Evidence of building and maintaining server-side APIs or services.

criteria.name: Data storage
criteria.description: Evidence of designing schemas, writing queries, or working with relational or non-relational databases.

criteria.name: Automated testing
criteria.description: Evidence of writing unit, integration, or API tests.

criteria.name: Production reliability
criteria.description: Evidence of monitoring, debugging, or improving services in production.

criteria.name: Security practices
criteria.description: Evidence of implementing authentication, authorization, or input validation.

name: Frontend Engineer
description: Build accessible web interfaces and integrate them with backend services. The role requires component design, browser fundamentals, testing, and performance work.

criteria.name: Web application development
criteria.description: Evidence of building web applications with JavaScript or TypeScript and a component-based framework.

criteria.name: API integration
criteria.description: Evidence of connecting interfaces to APIs and handling loading, errors, or application state.

criteria.name: Accessibility and responsive design
criteria.description: Evidence of accessible interfaces or layouts that support multiple screen sizes.

criteria.name: Frontend testing
criteria.description: Evidence of automated component, interaction, or end-to-end tests.

criteria.name: Performance
criteria.description: Evidence of measuring or improving rendering, bundle size, or page loading.

name: Project Manager
description: Plan and coordinate project work across stakeholders. The role covers scope, schedules, risks, budgets, and progress reporting.

criteria.name: Project planning
criteria.description: Evidence of creating project plans with scope, milestones, owners, or dependencies.

criteria.name: Risk management
criteria.description: Evidence of identifying risks and managing mitigation or escalation.

criteria.name: Stakeholder coordination
criteria.description: Evidence of coordinating stakeholders and reporting project progress.

criteria.name: Budget and resources
criteria.description: Evidence of managing project budgets, staffing, or resource allocation.

criteria.name: Delivery outcomes
criteria.description: Evidence of completing projects or meeting documented milestones.

name: Delivery Manager
description: Coordinate delivery across teams and maintain a predictable delivery process. The role covers dependencies, blockers, service quality, customer communication, and process improvement.

criteria.name: Multi-team delivery
criteria.description: Evidence of coordinating delivery across multiple teams or work streams.

criteria.name: Dependencies and blockers
criteria.description: Evidence of managing dependencies, removing blockers, or escalating delivery risks.

criteria.name: Delivery metrics
criteria.description: Evidence of using lead time, throughput, quality, or service measures to guide delivery.

criteria.name: Customer communication
criteria.description: Evidence of managing customer expectations and reporting delivery status.

criteria.name: Continuous improvement
criteria.description: Evidence of improving team processes or delivery practices.

name: Sales Executive
description: Develop business opportunities, manage a sales pipeline, and close relevant deals. Assess prospecting, discovery, negotiation, customer relationships, and stated sales results.

criteria.name: Prospecting
criteria.description: Evidence of identifying prospects or generating qualified leads.

criteria.name: Discovery and presentations
criteria.description: Evidence of understanding customer needs and presenting suitable products or services.

criteria.name: Pipeline management
criteria.description: Evidence of maintaining opportunities, forecasts, or CRM records.

criteria.name: Negotiation and closing
criteria.description: Evidence of negotiating terms or closing deals.

criteria.name: Sales results
criteria.description: Explicit evidence of quota attainment, revenue growth, or other measurable sales outcomes.

name: Business Analyst
description: Translate business needs into clear requirements and support delivery of process or system changes. The role covers stakeholder discovery, process analysis, documentation, and acceptance testing.

criteria.name: Requirements discovery
criteria.description: Evidence of gathering and analyzing requirements with business stakeholders.

criteria.name: Process analysis
criteria.description: Evidence of documenting current processes and identifying improvements.

criteria.name: Requirements documentation
criteria.description: Evidence of writing user stories, specifications, or acceptance criteria.

criteria.name: Data analysis
criteria.description: Evidence of using data, queries, or reports to support business decisions.

criteria.name: Acceptance testing
criteria.description: Evidence of planning or supporting user acceptance testing and validating requirements.

name: Supplier Onboarding Pack
description: Check whether a supplier pack contains the information needed for an initial onboarding review. Assess stated information only. Do not infer legal compliance, certificate authenticity, or supplier approval.

criteria.name: Business identity
criteria.description: The pack states the supplier business name and business address.

criteria.name: Contact details
criteria.description: The pack identifies a business contact and a contact method.

criteria.name: Products and services
criteria.description: The pack describes the products or services the supplier offers.

criteria.name: Commercial terms
criteria.description: The pack states pricing or pricing arrangements and payment terms.

criteria.name: Delivery information
criteria.description: The pack states delivery lead times and delivery locations or coverage.

criteria.name: Supporting documents
criteria.description: The pack lists supporting documents supplied and identifies their purpose and dates where applicable.

name: Product Specification
description: Check whether a product document provides enough explicit information to prepare a product listing. Requirements are a generic starting point and must be adapted to the product category. Do not infer product safety or regulatory compliance.

criteria.name: Product identity
criteria.description: The document states a product name and a product identifier such as SKU or model number.

criteria.name: Product description
criteria.description: The document describes the product purpose and main features.

criteria.name: Specifications
criteria.description: The document states relevant dimensions, materials, capacity, or other measurable specifications.

criteria.name: Packaging
criteria.description: The document states pack size, units per pack, or packaging details.

criteria.name: Variants
criteria.description: The document identifies available variants or explicitly states that there are none.

criteria.name: Handling information
criteria.description: The document includes applicable care, storage, installation, or handling instructions.

name: Statement of Work
description: Assess whether a statement of work makes project delivery expectations clear. This is an information-completeness review, not a legal assessment.

criteria.name: Scope and exclusions
criteria.description: The document defines the work in scope and exclusions or scope boundaries.

criteria.name: Deliverables
criteria.description: The document specifies concrete deliverables.

criteria.name: Owners and responsibilities
criteria.description: The document identifies responsibilities of the supplier and customer.

criteria.name: Schedule
criteria.description: The document includes milestones, dates, or an explicit delivery timeline.

criteria.name: Acceptance criteria
criteria.description: The document defines how deliverables will be reviewed and accepted.

criteria.name: Change process
criteria.description: The document states how changes to scope, timing, or cost will be handled.

name: Sales Proposal
description: Assess whether a sales proposal explains the customer need, proposed solution, commercial offer, and next step. Review the content rather than predicting a sales outcome.

criteria.name: Customer need
criteria.description: The proposal identifies the customer problem, need, or objective.

criteria.name: Proposed solution
criteria.description: The proposal explains the offered solution and how it addresses the stated need.

criteria.name: Scope and deliverables
criteria.description: The proposal states what is included in the offer.

criteria.name: Price and terms
criteria.description: The proposal includes a price or pricing basis and relevant commercial terms.

criteria.name: Delivery approach
criteria.description: The proposal states a delivery approach and expected timeline.

criteria.name: Next step
criteria.description: The proposal includes a clear next action or approval process.
